run_detcon_b_training: run the DetCon-B self-supervised pretraining experiment using Jaxline platform with a config file
create_binary_mask_from_felzenszwalb: create binary masks from Felzenszwalb segmentation masks by downsampling and reshaping for batch processing
sample_masks_for_loss: sample random binary masks using categorical distribution for use in the DetCon-B contrastive loss computation
run_detcon_b_forward_on_view: run the DetCon-B forward pass on a single view producing projections, predictions, and classification logits
compute_featurewise_std: compute the featurewise standard deviation by taking the mean of per-feature standard deviations across a JAX array
